scope: Separate AI content review of seven original synthetic packets and actual task outputs. Deterministic software replay does not repeat this reasoning.
method: Executors started in fresh contexts with their own raw packet and current RWT guidance, without tests or expected answers. Different agents independently read original inputs and actual outputs; observed defects were corrected by original executors and rechecked. Reviewers were not blinded to the outputs under review.
reviewer_scope_notes: One numeric reviewer disclosed one read of a global proof guide before the RWT-only scope was clarified; no guide text, code or task answers were copied. The subsequent checks used RWT guidance and independently written arithmetic. The private guide and its path are not distributed.
